description: Ask several independent public resolvers (Google, Cloudflare, DNS.SB, NextDNS) the same record over DNS-over-HTTPS and compare their answers. Returns each resolver's record set and DNS status, whether they all agree, and a note. Agreement is normal; a divergence flags a change still propagating, a stale cache, or split-horizon DNS — except when every resolver got addresses that all sit in one network (geoBalanced, with the shared ASN): that is a CDN/anycast or geo-DNS answering each resolver's location with its nearest edge, which is expected. Reads the resolvers' views — never queries the target host. Supports A/AAAA/CNAME/MX/NS/TXT/SOA/CAA. Read-only.

type.description: Record type: A (default), AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, TXT, SOA or CAA.

name: dns_propagation
